CLSA maintains Outperform on Radico Khaitan with target of ₹4909 CLSA maintains Outperform rating on Radico Khaitan with a target price of ₹4909. Q3 performance is tracking ahead of guidance following a healthy festive season. Vodka offers 2-3x the unit profitability of whisky at comparable price points, making it a structural growth and margin driver. Packaging and grain costs remain inflationary; new crop arrivals, FCI releases, and lower Scotch import duties could provide relief in H2. Firmer margin guidance is expected once raw material prices stabilise
